note: Input declarations of the CI parts (docs/ci.md#1-input-hash-result-reuse, scripts/ci-reuse.py). An executing part runs in a restricted checkout: every tracked file outside its declared inputs is withheld (present by name, unreadable), so a declaration that is too narrow fails the part instead of letting a result be reused for a change it read. `inputs` are content patterns, `exclude` removes paths from them; `defaults` apply to every part and `support` declares the restricted support jobs, whose inputs every part that needs them adds to its own.
